turns.prompt:
You are given one attached CSV file:
  - nlo_pool.csv: 100 CANDIDATE crystalline materials whose properties are
    NOT given, columns `candidate_id`, `formula` and `poscar` (the crystal
    structure, in POSCAR format).

No property values are provided. Using your knowledge of crystal optics,
crystal symmetry and structure-property relationships, predict which
candidates have the HIGHEST birefringence at 1064 nm, then select the 5 best
candidates from the pool.

Reason from the structures, then end your answer with an explicit ranked
list of candidate_ids, best first, e.g. "Final: c901, c902, c903, c904,
c905".
turns.answer_text:
The birefringence at 1064 nm is governed by anisotropy of the electronic polarizability tensor. Cubic crystals (identical lattice vectors) are isotropic and can be discarded at once. Tetrahedral/adamantine networks (zincblende, wurtzite, chalcopyrite and their polytypes, including all SiC entries) produce only small \(\Delta n\) (typically 0.03–0.05) because the polarizable bonds point in many directions.

Giant \(\Delta n\) instead requires low-dimensional packing of highly polarizable, intrinsically anisotropic units whose principal axes are aligned throughout the crystal:

- Isolated planar \(\mathrm{BS}_3\) triangles (all normals parallel to a single crystallographic axis) behave analogously to the carbonate groups of calcite, but with the larger polarizability of sulfur.
- Face- or edge-sharing \(\mathrm{GeI}_6\) (or \(\mathrm{Li}_2\mathrm{I}_3\)) chains/layers add the extreme polarizability of iodide together with a stereochemically active \(\mathrm{Ge}^{2+}\) lone pair.
- Polymeric 1-D \(\mathrm{AsS}_2^-\) chains likewise align both lone-pair and bond polarizabilities.

Inspection of the POSCAR lattices and fractional coordinates shows that these structural motifs occur in c039 (1-D \(\mathrm{GeI}_3\) chains), c054 (layered \(\mathrm{Li}_2\mathrm{I}_3\)), c040/c043 (perfectly co-aligned \(\mathrm{BS}_3\)), and c083 (1-D \(\mathrm{AsS}_2\) chains). All other chemistries in the pool are either three-dimensional networks or lack comparable alignment of polarizable groups, and therefore exhibit substantially smaller birefringence.

Final: c039, c054, c040, c043, c083
